summary: Cred provides a neutral to slightly bearish outlook on BTC and ETH, noting both tested resistance without rolling over but also no clear bullish setups. He identifies two potential long setups: momentum continuation requiring weekly acceptance above $47k targeting $58k, or a higher low pullback to $38-$40k zone with superior risk-reward. Market headwinds include central bank tightening, macro uncertainty, geopolitical tensions, large altcoin unlocks, and bearish high timeframe technicals. Cred emphasizes being extremely selective and prioritizing capital preservation in this challenging environment.
